title: Car Fleet
description: Determine the number of car fleets arriving at a destination. A fleet is formed if a trailing car catches up to a lead car.
pseudocode:
1. pairs = sort(position, speed) by position descending
2. stack = []
3. for p, s in pairs:
4.   time = (target - p) / s
5.   if stack is empty or time > stack.top():
6.     stack.push(time)
7. return stack.length

steps.note: Pairing position [10, 8, 0, 5, 3] and speed [2, 4, 1, 1, 3] and sorting by position descending.
Calculate time for first car at pos 10: (12-10)/2 = 1.0
Calculate time for car at pos 8: (12-8)/4 = 1.0
1.0 is not > 1.0, so this car joins the existing fleet.
Calculate time for car at pos 5: (12-5)/1 = 7.0
Calculate time for car at pos 3: (12-3)/3 = 3.0
3.0 is not > 7.0, car joins the fleet at 7.0.
Calculate time for car at pos 0: (12-0)/1 = 12.0
Final fleet count is the stack size: 3
